jobs.occupation: Business Consultant, Investment, Netcompany Banking Services
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about IT, business, and finance? As a Business Consultant, you will specialise in banking and investment, collaborating with clients and experienced colleagues to design IT solutions and develop expertise in investment processes and corporate actions.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Business Consultant with an interest in digitalisation and financial services to support initiatives within banking and investment. You will contribute to analysing business needs, mapping processes, and designing IT solutions in close collaboration with clients and colleagues. An interest in or basic knowledge of investment-related processes is an advantage.

You will join a team of highly experienced professionals who will support your continuous development towards a role as subject matter expert within IT solutions for banking and investment. Over time, you will build deep domain knowledge and develop into a go-to within banking and investment solutions.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• 
Analysing clients' business needs and translating and formulating requirements into IT solutions within the banking and investment domain.

• 
Mapping business processes and facilitating workshops with clients to identify needs, challenges, and opportunities for optimisation.

• 
Supporting the analysis and design of solutions related to investment processes.

• 
Collaborating with experienced colleagues and clients on solution design, testing, refinement, and implementation, while supporting user involvement, training, and change management where relevant.

• 
Building domain knowledge through hands-on project experience and knowledge sharing, with the opportunity to develop into a subject matter expert over time.

About you

You actively seek understanding by asking questions and encourage learning through curiosity and dialogue. You enjoy understanding how business processes work and how IT can support and improve them. Deadlines do not intimidate you, and you are willing to go the extra mile when needed. To succeed in this role, you:

• 
Are either a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, ideally working at the intersection of IT and business. Most importantly you are motivated to build specialized domain knowledge.

• 
Hold a relevant master's degree, such as Cand.merc. IT, Cand.it., or a similar degree with a focus on the intersection of finance and IT.

• 
Have a genuine interest in IT and digitalisation, preferably combined with an interest in finance, banking, investment, or financial services.

• 
Have an interest in or basic experience with investment-related processes, such as corporate actions. Previous experience within banking or investment is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

• Conduct onboarding sessions for new hires and ongoing training for existing staff to reinforce best practices.

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

We have more than 1,000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

**Our Purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**As our Lead Engineer- Data, you will set the architectural direction of the data platform that enables both the decisions we make internally and the data-driven features our customers rely on. Working with the Data, ML, Platform, and Product Engineering teams, you will keep ingestion, modelling, and orchestration dependable, and define the modelling, testing, and documentation standards the data function depends on. You will innovate on how people work with data, building the agentic tooling and semantic modelling that let teams across Planday work from trusted data with confidence.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Set the architectural direction of our data platform so it serves analytics, product engineering, and AI/ML from one coherent design, collaborating with Platform and ML engineering on shared infrastructure.

• Design the dbt models, semantic layer, and quality standards the data function depends on, with the validation and lineage to make them trustworthy downstream.

• Own orchestration and observability in Dagster, and onboarding new sources in a way that scales.

• Innovate on self-serve and AI-enabled analytics, from semantic models and agentic workflows to our BI layer.

• Build the historical and low-latency foundations that make predictive and real-time use cases possible.

• Introduce better modelling standards, tooling, and development environments.

• Keep the platform reliable, performant, cost-effective, and compliant.

**Success looks like

**

• Architecture that holds up as we scale and as new use cases emerge, and that other engineers follow as a pattern.

• Analysts ship faster and more efficiently because your tooling & standards remove friction.

• A drop in repeat requests to the data team, as stakeholders answer their own questions through agentic workflows.

• ML and product teams have the historical and real-time data they need, without bespoke workarounds.

• Strong working relationships with the Data, ML, and Platform teams.

**What You’ll Bring With You

**

• Deep, hands-on Snowflake and dbt experience: modelling, semantic layers, agents & skills, testing, performance and cost tuning.

• Production experience with a pipeline orchestrator, ideally Dagster (or similar Airflow, Prefect), including dependent workloads, partial failures, and observability.

• Modern cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS/GCP) and Kubernetes experience deploying and operating containerised workloads, plus infrastructure as code (Terraform).

• Strong SQL & Python for pipelines, services, and automation.

• Software engineering discipline across CI/CD, testing, and code review.

• The ability to turn technical trade-offs into clear narratives that help stakeholders decide and trust the work.

• Experience operating data systems, including incident response, cost, and data privacy practices.

**At Planday, we offer you

**

• Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• Flexible remote work

• Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

_At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

jobs.occupation: Business Controller - Drive Financial Insight and Business Performance
jobs.description:
Join us as a Business Controller

Are you passionate about turning complex information into clear business insights? Do you enjoy asking questions, challenging assumptions and investigating unexpected trends to understand the business behind the numbers, not just reporting them?

We are looking for a skilled and business-oriented Business Controller to join our Finance & Controlling team. This is a full-time role based in Copenhagen, structured as a hybrid position that combines office presence with some work-from-home flexibility.

What is the job about?

As a Business Controller, you will be much more than the owner of reports and forecasts. You will act as a trusted business partner, helping our management team understand what is happening in the business, why it is happening and what we should do next.

You will work across our insurance operations in Denmark, Sweden and Norway, partnering closely with colleagues in Claims, Sales, Underwriting, Operations, Finance, IT and other business functions to improve business performance. Through high-quality financial controlling, analysis and reporting, you will provide reliable insights and ensure transparency, accuracy and compliance.

Your qualifications

• Experience in Business Controlling, FP&A or another finance business partnering role is required.

• Strong analytical and commercial mindset, with experience analysing business performance.

• Experience with or understanding of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and business planning.

• Ability to communicate complex financial topics clearly to non-financial stakeholders.

• Experience with Excel and BI tools, combined with the ability to use AI effectively

• Familiarity with ERP (e.g. SAP GT) systems is an advantage

• Experience working with large datasets and translating analysis into business recommendations.

• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline.

What will make you successful?

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you:

• Are genuinely curious about how businesses work.

• You are motivated by understanding complexity.

• Like asking “Why?” until you reach the root cause.

• You remain optimistic and persistent despite struggles.

• You like solving new problems along with routine tasks.

• Are comfortable making decisions without having every answer upfront.

• Build relationships across functions because you know the best insights rarely come from spreadsheets alone.

• Have the confidence to challenge assumptions, supported by facts rather than opinions.

• Take pride in helping others make better decisions through data and insight.

What we offer?

We offer an exciting opportunity to join a professional and collaborative finance environment where you can make a tangible impact on business performance.

You will have the opportunity to:

• Work with complex financial and business-related challenges

• Collaborate with experienced professionals across local and central / headquarter functions

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting, planning, and governance processes

• Further develop your technical expertise and business understanding

• Play an active role in supporting strategic and operational decision-making

If you are motivated by financial analysis, business partnering, and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you.

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Department: Finance & Controlling

Reporting to: Head of Controlling

How to apply

If you would like to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact:

Edgards Baumanis

Nordic Head of Controlling

Email: Edgars.Baumanis@ergo.dk

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please send your CV and application to hr@ergo.dk

We look forward to hearing from you!

Who we are

ERGO Forsikring A/S is one of the leading insurance companies in the Nordic region, formed through the merger of Europæiske Rejseforsikring A/S and ERGO Forsikring AS. The company provides health and travel insurance solutions in Denmark, Norway and Sweden. In Denmark, travel insurance is offered under the Europæiske ERV brand, which has more than 100 years of experience in safeguarding travellers, while health insurance is delivered to businesses under the ERGO Forsikring brand.

ERGO Forsikring A/S is part of ERGO Group AG, a major international insurance group and the primary insurance arm of Munich Re. You will join an organisation with strong regional roots and global backing, focused on reliability, customer security and long-term partnerships.

Directure is an international management consulting firm devoted to advising and assisting organisations within life science, healthcare and other regulated industries, to realise their strategy aspirations. We operate through an integrated approach to consulting, combining best practice standards and disciplines of Management Consulting, International Search and People Resource Consulting. Today, Directure advises a variety of companies that seek guidance and counselling on business and senior leadership needs with an increasing access to executives around the world. We combine the in-depth expertise of an international advisor with the focus and flexibility of a boutique consulting firm that has put impact above size.

Team Assistant

The Role

Directure's consultants run complex, multi-client advisory practices. They need someone close — someone who keeps the operational side running with precision while also contributing to the polished outputs clients receive.

The role is onsite and sits at the intersection of those characteristics. You will own the administrative infrastructure that keeps consultants effective — diary management, travel, planning, correspondence — and you will contribute directly to client deliverables: communications, reports and advanced PowerPoint presentations built to a consulting standard.

Responsibilities

Two distinct, equally important areas of work

Administration & Coordination

• Own and manage complex partner and consultant diaries — scheduling, sequencing, and protecting time for deep work

• Plan and coordinate all travel: flights, accommodation, ground logistics, and changes in the field

• Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up actions; manage correspondence independently where appropriate

• Track project timelines, upcoming milestones, and internal team deadlines across active engagements

• Administrative coordination with Finance.

• Maintain organised filing systems and document libraries for ongoing project matters

• Build and maintain advanced PowerPoint presentations — slide logic, visual hierarchy, data visualisation — to a standard appropriate for senior client audiences. Assist in preparing pitch materials, proposals, and thought-leadership content

• Quality-check outputs before client delivery: language, consistency, and visual finish

What We're Looking For

Skills, background, and ways of working

• An academic degree and + 2 years of FTE experience in a professional services, consulting, corporate, or equivalent environment — you understand what high-standard output looks like

• Strong PowerPoint skills are essential: you can build a structured, visually coherent presentation from a brief, not just populate a template

• Organised in a way that holds under pressure: priorities shift, deadlines accelerate, and you adapt without dropping things

• Excellent written communication in English – native or proficiency; your drafts need minimal editing before they go out

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and quick to learn tools you haven't used before

• Discreet and professional in your handling of sensitive information; you understand what confidentiality means in a client-facing environment

• Curious about the work itself — you want to understand the engagements you're supporting, not just manage the calendar around them

The remuneration reflects your qualifications.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a brief cover letter under reference "TA" to career@directure.com. Please note that we will invite, interview and select among candidates on an ongoing basis. We look forward to receiving your application, which will be treated in strictest confidence.

For more information about Directure please visit: www.directure.com

The Impact You'll Make

Join our two-year Graduate Program and become part of a team that turns ideas into real impact. You will contribute to business-critical projects, work across functions and develop an understanding of how a global industrial company operates. From day one, you’ll take on meaningful challenges, bring your perspective to complex problems and help create smarter, more sustainable solutions for people and the planet.

How The Program Works

Starting 1 September 2027, you’ll complete three 8-month rotations, building functional expertise, strengthening your project and collaboration skills and exploring where you can contribute most. Your journey starts at our headquarters in Nordborg or Graasten, Denmark and continues in regions such as the USA, Asia or Europe.

You’ll work in cross-functional teams - from office spaces to production floors -, gaining a full picture of how global business, innovation and sustainability connect at Danfoss.

After completing the program, you’ll be well prepared to take on future opportunities - potentially moving into a permanent role at Danfoss that aligns with your strengths, ambitions and career path.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Take ownership of projects across functions like Engineering, Sales or Operations & Supply Chain.

• Collaborate and implement solutions with experts, mentors and peers from all over the world.

• Analyze problems and translate findings into practical improvements.

• Learn fast, challenge the status quo and shape the future of Danfoss.

What We're Looking For

• A Master’s degree in Engineering (mechanical, electrical, industrial, or mechatronics), Supply Chain or Economics with graduation in 2026 or 2027.

• Recently graduated, with a maximum of two years of full-time professional work experience after graduation.

• Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken.

• Enjoy learning, exploring new ideas and improving how things work.

• Work well across cultures and value inclusion, teamwork and respect.

• Have experience from an internship or student project.

What You'll Get From Us

• Learning & Mentoring: You’ll have a dedicated mentor, a buddy, project-based learning and structured workshops to understand the business.

• Global Opportunities: Experience diverse cultures, build your international network and discover your best-fit career path.

• Flexibility & Well-being: We support balance, trust and autonomy so you can do your best work and take care of yourself.

• Inclusive Culture: Be part of a workplace where you can bring your whole self -your background, ideas and ambitions all matter.

• Competitive Benefits: You’ll receive a fair, transparent compensation package including paid vacation, pension, personal insurance. Don’t worry about the move to Denmark, we offer a relocation package, accommodation support and more - details vary by country.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this program excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply between 2 November 2026 and 18 December 2026.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That’s okay - potential matters more than perfection.

If you’re curious, motivated and ready to grow, we encourage you to apply.

Our Commitment to Transparency

Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our FAQ Page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Administrative Coordinator for Post fixture assistance in Bioenergy
jobs.description:
Join us in this role where you’ll be part of a department handling more than 550 import vessels and 25,000 biomass truck deliveries annually to our power plants across Denmark. Our team ensures that our power plants always have the feedstock they need, enabling Ørsted to deliver heat and power to local communities. Looking ahead, logistics will also play a significant role in the transportation of CO₂, adding an exciting new dimension to our responsibilities. We work cross-departmental in the company with e.g. Fuel Procurement, Back Office, Finance and Sustainability who all rely on our swift, accurate and efficient support.

**Welcome to Bioenergy - Customers & Markets

**You’ll be part of Shipping & Logistics where you, together with your colleagues, will contribute to respective areas of expertise when needed. In-depth SAP knowledge, confidence in creating and managing purchase orders, and the ability to handle fast-track payments are important parts of the role. Strong Excel skills and a competitive commercial mindset is essential. Knowledge and experience within shipping and logistics is a clear advantage, and you must be able to read and understand contracts, to ensure operations are carried out in accordance with the agreed terms. As a team, we are six colleagues with a flat organizational structure, where collaboration, trust, flexibility and a willingness to help one another are essential to how we work.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• providing fundamental input and improvement suggestions to enhance efficiency and optimize processes incl. preparing and developing PowerPoint presentations for internal and external use

• contributing to the continued growth of Bioenergy and supporting the department’s commercial and operational activities

• acting as the department’s SAP expert, requiring in-depth knowledge and understanding of relevant SAP processes and functionalities

• independently creating and maintaining purchase orders and ensuring accurate and timely administration

• performing post-fixture activities, including laytime calculations, port turnaround figures for both own and external vessels, and tonnage reporting

• collaborating, both verbally and in writing in Danish and English, with shipowners, operators, brokers, surveyors, truck haulers and other external partners, as well as colleagues across the Orsted organization.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• are a Team player and at the same time strive working independently

• laugh easily and appreciate an informal tone and further more you possess curiosity and willingness to learn

• love fast pace at work and are not afraid of being challenged even though it might be out of your comfortzone

• possess a thorough practical knowledge of SAP and Excel

• think and act commercially and know how to calculate in days, hours and minutes (laytime)

• see yourself growing as the position is a natural stepping stone towards a Logistics Coordinator role, where you gradually will take on more responsibility and a broader range of independent tasks.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**For this position, the expected base pay range is according to collective agreement relevant for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. jobs.occupation: Senior Peptide Scientist – Drug Discovery and Early Innovation
jobs.description:
Do you want to drive innovation and collaborate in an ever-evolving field of drug discovery?

Do you want to help decide which therapeutic ideas to pursue and generate the first experimental evidence to move them forward? At Gubra, you can look forward to seeing your contributions develop into tangible projects, partnerships and results, supported by colleagues who work together to drive ideas forward.

Connect peptide discovery with early innovation.

We are looking for a Senior Peptide Scientist with deep peptide drug discovery expertise, sound scientific judgement and curiosity about new therapeutic opportunities to focus on designing, innovating, and coordinating activities that drive our drug discovery projects forward.

Your role will be shared equally between Chemistry and Drug Discovery Innovation. You will bring chemistry expertise into innovation campaigns and connect new therapeutic ideas with the knowledge and capabilities of the Chemistry department.

As an idea lead within the innovation team, you will take ownership of and contribute directly to the overall opportunity assessment, applying your understanding of the target biology and integrating specialist input to assess patient relevance, value proposition, differentiation and discovery feasibility. You will identify key risks and evidence gaps and develop clear recommendations where further investigation is needed.

Within Chemistry, you will lead the scientific design and coordination of the initial experimental phase, evaluating drug concepts in the first two project stages. You will coordinate experimental work carried out in close collaboration with the department’s laboratory technicians, draw on the expertise of scientists supporting the laboratory workflows, and interpret results with colleagues across disciplines.

As projects progress, you will ensure a clear handover of the scientific ownership to a discovery project scientist.

Your primary tasks will be to:

• Lead opportunity assessments that integrate biological rationale, human evidence, unmet medical need, the treatment landscape, strategic fit, competitive positioning and relevant intellectual property.

• Assess peptide modality fit and chemical feasibility across innovation campaigns, identifying key risks, evidence gaps and capabilities that need to be developed or accessed externally.

• Engage Chemistry scientists and coordinate specialist contributions to feasibility assessments.

• Design initial peptide compounds and experimental plans, coordinate synthesis and evaluation, and integrate findings with colleagues from Molecular Pharmacology, Computational Drug Discovery, Pharmaceutical Development, DMPK, and Translational Pharmacology.

• Present balanced recommendations on next steps and ensure a clear scientific handover when projects progress.

Deep peptide expertise and curiosity about new therapeutic opportunities

You bring substantial experience in peptide drug discovery and understand how molecular design choices shape the properties of a successful drug concept. You evaluate evidence critically, recognize uncertainty and identify the experiments needed to make a decision.

You may already have experience assessing new therapeutic opportunities, or you may be an accomplished peptide discovery scientist ready to take on broader idea leadership. In either case, you draw on colleagues’ specialist expertise while taking ownership of the overall assessment and recommendation.

Your experience and qualifications include:

• A PhD in chemistry, peptide chemistry or a related discipline, or an MSc with substantial relevant industry experience.

• Strong industry experience in peptide drug discovery, including peptide design, synthesis strategies and interpretation of structure–activity relationships.

• Experience optimizing peptide potency, selectivity, stability and exposure, using approaches relevant to the drug concept.

• The ability to integrate chemistry, analytical, biological and DMPK data to support clear scientific decisions.

• An understanding of the wider drug R&D value chain and how early target and modality choices influence later development.

Experience in early innovation, target assessment or cross-functional project coordination is an advantage. Most importantly, you are motivated to apply your peptide expertise to new therapeutic questions and develop your ability to lead opportunity assessments.

You work independently, take ownership and communicate complex science clearly. You share early ideas, challenge assumptions constructively and adapt your view as the evidence emerges. You build effective relationships and involve the right colleagues to move an assessment or experimental plan forward.

Chemistry and Drug Discovery Innovation at Gubra – your new Teams

You will be based at Gubra HQ in Hørsholm, Greater Copenhagen, working closely with colleagues in both departments. You will build a broad collaborative across multiple specialist functions network to evaluate opportunities and establish the evidence for new discovery projects.

The role offers the opportunity to influence our future project portfolio while remaining closely connected to peptide discovery. You will help make innovation a shared scientific effort by bringing ideas into Chemistry and departmental expertise into innovation decisions.

Contact and application

Please apply no later than December 1, 2026, by uploading your motivated cover letter and resume on our website.

If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Senior Department Manager, Martin Kræmer at mkr@gubra.dk.

We are looking forward to receiving your application.

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialized in peptide-based drug discovery and development as well as preclinical contract research services striving for excellence at all levels. We insist on doing things efficiently - and often differently - to reach the results we aim for. Our vision is to become leaders in the path towards a more sustainable and healthier world. We do that by facilitating the discovery of new medicine, and by acting and inspiring others to fight the ongoing climate and biodiversity crises.

Gubra’s activities are focused on the early stages of drug development and are organised in two main highly synergistic business areas: Biotech and CRO Services. We generate our revenue by performing research for life science companies as well as by partnering projects from our discovery and development pipeline.

Our therapeutic focus is within metabolic and fibrotic diseases, and we specialize in in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, stereology and whole brain and organ imaging. In addition, we offer a full palette of advanced transcriptomics. Our ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform streaMLine enables us to rapidly develop a peptide hit into a non-clinical candidate ready for development. Through a constant focus on high quality, scientific excellence, speed, and solid teamwork we have established ourselves as a highly professional and competent partner in the market.

People are our greatest asset, and our team consists of around 320 employees of which many are located in Hørsholm, Denmark. The mix of people from different cultures and educational backgrounds combined with our entrepreneurial mindset have greatly impacted our working environment, which is characterized by entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity, and teamwork – we join forces!

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. From our people who are caring, candid, and impact-driven to our business, which is innovative and rooted in science, we believe that being proudly unique, determined to be our best, and authentic is essential to fulfilling our purpose.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to drive complex projects in Genmab’s late-stage CMC project organization. You will translate project strategies into integrated plans and coordinate delivery across internal teams and contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).

Working within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Supply Chain to advance late-stage programs towards regulatory submission and commercial readiness.

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of project delivery, influence cross-functional decisions and strengthen project management practices through mentoring and continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities

**CMC project planning and delivery

• Develop and execute integrated project plans, timelines and milestones aligned with the Drug Development Plan. Provide input to optimize project strategy and translate agreed priorities into clear deliverables

• Coordinate internal and external activities, including technology transfer, process validation and manufacturing readiness, managing cross-functional dependencies and ensuring clear ownership and timely delivery

• Lead proactive risk management, prioritizing risks and driving mitigation, escalation and resolution. Maintain current plans, dashboards, action and decision logs, and communicate progress and emerging issues

Supplier coordination and regulatory readiness

• Create and oversee statements of work with relevant functions. Manage project budgets and forecasts, track invoices and proactively address variances against agreed scope, costs and timelines

• Coordinate CDMO and other external partner activities, follow up on deliverables and gather stakeholder input on vendor performance. Build effective relationships and resolve issues collaboratively

• Conduct line-of-business reviews of regulatory documentation supporting global submissions. Ensure technical compliance and timely delivery of source documentation in collaboration with subject matter experts and Regulatory Affairs

• Ensure adherence to Genmab’s quality system requirements. Understand the technical implications of supplier quality agreements, flag risks and coordinate follow-up with Quality and relevant functions

Project governance and ways of working

• Represent project management in internal and external forums. Communicate priorities, risks and recommendations, align stakeholders on decisions and ensure agreed actions are documented and followed through

• Use lessons learned to recommend and implement improvements to project management processes, systems and tools, strengthening consistency and operational effectiveness across the organization

• Train, mentor and guide colleagues in project management practices. Share experience and support effective project execution through informal leadership and constructive feedback

**Requirements

**

• 
Master’s degree in science, engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience. An advanced degree or relevant certification is an advantage

• 
At least six years of experience in Tech Ops or a related field within a relevant industry, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

• 
Demonstrated success managing complex projects in a cross-functional environment, preferably within late-stage biologics development, with strong planning, budget and risk management skills

• 
Proven ability to influence and coordinate multicultural teams and internal and external stakeholders without direct authority

• 
Solid experience managing CDMOs and contract research organizations, with a strong understanding of intellectual property implications

• 
Sound knowledge of pharmaceutical regulations, GMP and regulatory documentation requirements, and their application to CMC project delivery.

• 
Experience implementing process or system improvements, with strong proficiency in project management systems, dashboards and reporting tools.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to present complex topics and recommendations clearly

The role is based in Denmark. Travel is expected to be approximately 10–15 days per year.

Genmab leverages the effectiveness of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are designed as open, community-based spaces that work to connect our employees. Whether you’re in one of our collaboratively designed office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK644.640,00---966.960,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Are you ready to bring fresh ideas to life, make an impact across channels, and help strengthen our employer brand across JYSK markets?

As our Employer Branding Coordinator, you'll help JYSK attract future colleagues through engaging digital campaigns, insights, and close collaboration with local HR teams across our markets and central departments at Head Office. You'll have the opportunity to grow your career in employer branding while combining new ideas with hands-on execution, analysis, and coordination.

This role is ideal for someone early in their career who is eager to learn, take ownership, and grow their impact over time, while also being comfortable with recurring operational and administrative tasks. We're looking for a proactive, solution-oriented person who enjoys identifying opportunities, bringing new ideas forward, and turning them into action while still respecting concepts and company rules.

The position reports to the central Employer Branding Manager at Head Office.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You will become part of the central Talent Acquisition department and play a key role in supporting both recruitment and employee experience across JYSK markets.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Hands-on responsibility for paid employer branding and recruitment campaigns.

• An international role with close cooperation across local markets and central departments.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• Room to bring forward ideas, test improvements and stay close to social media trends.

• A collaborative culture built on trust, teamwork and freedom with responsibility.

• The opportunity to gradually take on broader responsibility, drive projects, and help shape employer branding across JYSK markets.

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

Your main focus will be to help strengthen JYSK's employer brand and attract future colleagues across our markets. You will do this through hands-on work with digital campaigns, performance insights, and close collaboration with stakeholders, continuously identifying opportunities to improve results and create impact.

Your tasks and responsibilities include:

Content & Channels

• Monitor and execute employer branding activities across Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, keeping content engaging, relevant, and on brand, ensuring the JYSK brand guideline is followed and concepts are respected

• Spot opportunities to improve our social media presence and proactively drive new ideas and improvements.

• Support audience targeting, budget allocation and paid campaign optimisation.

• Stay curious about digital trends, emerging formats, and audience behaviour, turning ideas into practical improvements.

• Write engaging social media copy and support simple creative adaptations with JYSK tone of voice.

• Assist with simple creative adaptations using tools such as Adobe Express.

Operations and process support:

• Work closely with local markets and internal partners to support employer branding and talent attraction activities.

• Contribute ideas and challenge existing ways of working to improve processes, campaigns, and collaboration.

• Support day-to-day activities, including recurring operational and administrative tasks, to keep things running smoothly.

Data & Insights

• Track employer branding and campaign performance, turning data into clear insights and recommendations to improve future content and campaigns.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

You are curious, outgoing, and eager to make things happen. You enjoy working with people, sharing ideas, and learning along the way. You are motivated by taking ownership, finding better ways of doing things, and continuously developing yourself. You like variety, take initiative, and are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done.

You should bring:

• A relevant degree in media, communications, marketing or a related field.

• Interest in HR, recruitment or employer branding.

• Some hands-on experience with paid media campaign setup, optimisation or reporting. Knowing Meta Business Manager and/or TikTok Manager are a plus.

• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and the confidence to share ideas and take initiative.

• Good organisational skills with the ability to manage different priorities and meet deadlines, while still keeping an eye on details.

• The ability to turn insights into meaningful, practical actions, informed by data.

• A collaborative, flexible approach and a willingness to support local markets and departments.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; other languages are an advantage.

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? APPLY TODAY!

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To help us review applications fairly and efficiently, we use a system that automatically checks and decides how well each application matches the role.

This system looks at your answers to a few screening questions. These questions were created by the system and reviewed by the JYSK Talent Acquisition team, and each question and answer have a certain value. Based on your answers, the system ranks all candidates to give us an idea of how closely the job fits your profile.

This helps us manage all applications and make sure everyone is treated equally. The result from the system decides if your application moves forward to the next step. But don’t worry - the final decision is always made by a person.

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

Stibo DX is the company behind Cue, our multimedia enterprise platform used by media organizations around the world to create, manage, and deliver content across digital and print channels.

As Cue evolves from self-hosted and hybrid deployments towards a standardized, cloud-native SaaS platform, the way our platform connects, exchanges data, and governs information is becoming increasingly important. Creating greater consistency across APIs, integrations, events, schemas, and data ownership is therefore one of our key architectural priorities.

As our Senior Integration & Data Architect, you will take ownership of shaping a more unified, governed, and decoupled integration and data architecture across Cue. You will help us tackle fragmentation and inconsistency across the platform and establish clear architectural patterns that enable our product and engineering teams to build and evolve solutions with greater speed and confidence.

This is very much a hands-on architecture role. You will not simply define principles and governance from a distance. You will work directly with teams on real designs, APIs, event contracts, integrations, schemas, and data domains, helping translate architectural direction into solutions that work in practice. You will work with modern architectural approaches and technologies such as API-first design, GraphQL/REST, Kafka, CDC, schema evolution, and multi-tenant SaaS.

You will become part of a small, but senior architecture team with significant autonomy, visibility, and responsibility. Working closely with our Platform Architect, who focuses on runtime, multi-tenancy, and observability, and our Senior Software Architect, who focuses on domain boundaries and solution design, you will have the opportunity to influence how the entire Cue platform develops as we continue our SaaS transformation.

You will report to the Director of Solution Architecture, and you will work within an architecture governance model keeping decisions close to the teams, while applying the right level of architectural guidance based on risk. The role can be based at any of our offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Oslo, Málaga, or Hamburg, depending on where you are located.

Key responsibilities

• Define and govern the unified API strategy for CUE (REST and GraphQL), design standards, versioning, deprecation, breaking-change discipline, and consistency across teams.

• Design integration patterns for a modular, microservices-based platform, sync vs async, anti-corruption layers, adapters, and migration from bespoke customer integrations to standardized platform interfaces; guide teams on when to use events vs APIs and how to avoid tight coupling.

• Own event-driven architecture on Kafka, topic design, event contracts, schema evolution, CDC/streaming, and consistency models (ordering, idempotency, replay).

• Establish data domains and governance, ownership models, schema definition and evolution, metadata, lineage, quality, classification, retention, and compliance readiness.

• Align contracts with domain boundaries, connect bounded contexts, domain events, and service ownership to API, event, and data design, in close collaboration with the Software Architect.

• Enable teams through architecture leadership, produce reference architectures and integration blueprints, shepherd ADRs, review high-risk designs, and coach teams on better patterns without blocking delivery.

• Reduce fragmentation and drive consolidation, identify one-off approaches early and steer teams toward reusable platform standards.

• Partner across architecture and delivery, work with platform, product, and engineering teams to ensure standards are usable, adopted, and durable.

What you will bring

You are someone who naturally takes ownership and looks beyond individual solutions to understand what is best for the platform as a whole. You notice fragmentation, inconsistencies, and emerging risks, and you are proactive in bringing people together to find practical ways forward.

You are comfortable working across engineering, architecture, and product, and you know how to turn complex integration and data topics into clear, pragmatic decisions that teams can actually work with. You build credibility through your expertise, but also through collaboration, listening, and an understanding that strong architecture needs to support delivery rather than slow it down.

You believe in strong standards where they matter, while taking a pragmatic, risk-based approach to governance. You are curious and adaptable, care about quality and maintainability, and are motivated by creating clarity around contracts, data ownership, and architectural boundaries. Ultimately, you enjoy bringing coherence to complex platforms and leaving them in a better architectural state than you found them.

Experience

• 10+ years in software engineering, integration engineering, data engineering, or architecture, with 5+ years in a senior role focused on integration, APIs, events, and/or data architecture.

• Proven experience designing and governing APIs in large, distributed, multi-team environments.

• Strong experience with REST and GraphQL API design, versioning, and contract-first approaches.

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture in production, preferably Kafka.

• Experience with integration patterns: messaging, pub/sub, request/reply, outbox, saga/process manager, and CDC.

• Strong understanding of schema modeling and schema evolution for APIs and events.

• Experience defining data domains, ownership models, and data governance in a product or platform context.

• Ability to connect Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts (bounded contexts, domain events, aggregates) to integration and data design.

• Understanding of AWS, Kubernetes-based platforms, and multi-tenant SaaS implications for data isolation and integration boundaries.

• Security-aware design across APIs and events, authentication, authorization, zero-trust principles.

Interested?

Please apply here on LinkedIn. You are encouraged to apply at your earliest convenience. Short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview. Applications are processed as they are received until the right candidate is found.

Should you have questions about the position, you are also welcome to contact Director, Safdar Aqeel via mail safs@stibodx.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

Nordic Commercial & Pricing Specialist

• Full-time

• Field of interest: Technology, Transformation & Data

• Level of hire: Experienced hire

Company Description

Do you enjoy turning financial insight into commercial impact? Join Deloitte’s Nordic Sales Excellence Team to develop compelling pricing strategies and commercial solutions that deliver value for clients and strengthen profitability. This is an exciting opportunity to help increase the win rate and shape commercial decisions for Deloitte’s largest and most important deals.

About us

With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

Join our diverse Nordic Technology & Transformation Sales Excellence team and help shape Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits. The team helps win deals and improve profitability through compelling pricing and commercial propositions for our clients. We provide expert advice on all commercial aspects of client proposals, focusing primarily on higher-value, more complex deals and Deloitte’s most important Nordic clients.

This role can be placed either in Copenhagen, Denmark or in Oslo, Norway.

Job Description

What will be your role?

We aim to become the largest professional services firm in the Nordics by continuously innovating, evolving and adapting to meet clients’ needs. To achieve this, we need to strengthen our commercial expertise to support our most complex deals, to our most important clients. You will play a key role in our Nordic Sales Excellence team, and your worksite is therefore flexible within the Nordics.

As our Commercial and Pricing Specialist, your role will be to structure and shape commercial solutions to respond to our client’s requirements and challenges and to help win business and improve profitability. You will work closely with the rest of the Nordic Sales Excellence Team and the stakeholders for our major Nordic accounts to shape commercial arrangements.

The core responsibilities of your role include:

• Shape commercial solutions for complex opportunities, bringing together clients’ needs, pricing options and commercial considerations into compelling proposals

• Develop pricing strategies and structures that demonstrate value to clients and improve our ability to win work

• Build and challenge deal economics through financial modelling, testing margins, assumptions, pricing scenarios and commercial risks

• Partner with proposal teams to design and implement commercial strategies that grow revenue and strengthen profitability

• Advance value-based pricing by helping pursuit teams identify and quantify expected clients’ outcomes, then translate them into appropriate pricing models

• Support proposals and negotiations by clearly articulating the pricing structure and commercial assumptions, and advising on terms and trade-offs

• Build commercial capability across the Nordics through practical guidance, training, knowledge sharing and improvements to the various tools and ways of working

Qualifications

Who are we looking for?

You are a commercially minded professional with strong analytical and modelling skills, together with good business acumen. We are looking for a team player with a collegiate style who enjoys working, collaborating and having fun with team-mates.

We imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years’ experience in pricing, commercial finance, deal shaping or a related commercial role; professional-services experience is an advantage

• A strong financial modelling and Excel skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations

• Experience with leveraging AI applications in commercial work, with the judgement to evaluate outputs

• Confidence working with senior stakeholders and collaborating across functions and countries

• Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain pricing choices and commercial terms

• It would be desirable, but not essential, to have professional services experience and insights, ideally having worked within a consulting or professional service organisation

• Flexibility to meet peaks of work inherent in the cycle of a deal

• Proficient in written and spoken English. Knowledge of another Scandinavian language is a benefit

Work permit: We are only able to consider applicants with a valid work permit in Denmark/Norway.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What impact will your role make?

Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. Deloitte is where you’ll find unlimited opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.

Additional Information

Do you want to be a part of our team?

Please submit your CV and answer a few questions about your experience. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the position once the right candidate has been identified.

Application deadline is December 1, 2026.

Please do not hesitate to contact Inu Agarwal at inuagarwal@deloitte.no if you have any questions about the position.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.
